limitation: Continue each latest epoch-40 checkpoint, including AdamW and full history, to a common total of 100 epochs. Physical batching changes affect subsequent dropout draws; this is a documented continuation with unchanged learning hyperparameters, not a bitwise replay of the former execution. Single seed, V_select only. Formal launch is manual.
